attr.title: Guitar Hero III (native)
attr.desc: A native player for Guitar Hero III's own PC data files: the full set list, lead guitar or bass/rhythm, four difficulties, hammer-ons, sustains and star power, with the game's note-judging rules. Bring your own copy of the game's DATA folder.
attr.inst: Copy the game's DATA folder (at least PAK/, SONGS/ and MUSIC/) to ports/gh3/DATA/. See README.md.
